title: Huawei Cloud to Release First Ascend-Native Embodied World Model CloudRoboWM1.2
excerpt: Huawei Cloud will hold an online launch event from 14:00 to 15:30 on November 16 to officially unveil its first Ascend-native embodied world model, CloudRoboWM1
content_html:
Huawei Cloud will hold an online launch event from 14:00 to 15:30 on November 16 to officially unveil its first Ascend-native embodied world model, CloudRoboWM1.2, aiming to drive embodied intelligence from laboratory R&D to large-scale deployment across industries.

According to the disclosed agenda, the model will be officially launched by Wu Xiaodong, President of Huawei Cloud's Embodied Product Line and Director of the Embodied Intelligence Lab. Afterwards, Liu Liu, Chief Model Expert at Huawei Cloud's Embodied Intelligence Lab, will explain the architecture and core capabilities of Huawei Cloud's embodied world model, while Ding Zhibin, Head of Huawei Cloud's Embodied Intelligence Industry Ecosystem, will introduce the CloudRobo ecosystem co-building plan.

From an industry layout perspective, Huawei Cloud previously launched the CloudRobo Embodied Intelligence Platform in June 2025 and officially released the "Industry AI Dream Factory · Embodied Intelligence Zone" in June 2026. This launch of the Ascend-native embodied world model is an important move by Huawei Cloud to further improve its embodied intelligence technology and industry ecosystem layout, and will also provide new support for the coordinated development of domestic computing power and embodied intelligence models.
